capabilities: Enforce task item limits per section using [limit=N] tags
Highlight lines that exceed the limit
Optionally count completed tasks toward the limit
extras: Listing notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to cap how many task items a section may contain or to see when a list exceeds a work-in-progress limit.
summary: Task limit plugin that caps task items per section via [limit=N] tags and visually highlights over-limit lines.
